test_title: PYST 27 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 22 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Which of the following sentences uses the word "trip" with a different meaning from the others?

options.text: The unexpected boulder made him trip and fall.
He was so clumsy that he would trip over his own feet.
He walked carefully so he wouldn't trip on the uneven pavement.
Our annual family trip to the beach was unforgettable.
